title: Tech Tuesday: Descartes Acquires Tai Software for $100 Million
excerpt: Epicor bolsters platform with AI agents for Latin America.
content_html:
This week we hear that ePost Global and QuickBox have shored up their partnership to give e-commerce retailers better global and cross-border capabilities to help them expand. And Descartes Systems Group snatched up Tai Software, which offers an AI-powered transportation management platform for freight brokers. And lastly, Epicor updated its platform with AI agents to help supply chain companies in Latin America improve their workflows.

 Descartes acquires Tai for $100 million 

The Descartes Systems Group, the global logistics network and technology company, said it acquired Tai Software, a California-based provider of advanced transportation solutions for freight brokers.

  • ClearJet Raises $25M to Rethink Air-to-Ground Parcel Delivery Networks

  • KetteQ Launches Its "Free-Range" AI for Supply Chains

Descartes said it acquired Tai for approximately $100 million, "satisfied from cash on hand."

The company said Tai offers the market an AI-powered transportation management platform, which serves as a "system of action for freight brokers." Tai's platform coordinates shipment lifecycle across truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL), drayage as well as cross-border operations.

"By unifying quoting, carrier sourcing, load execution, billing and customer engagement in a single workflow, Tai helps brokers automate operations and make better decisions faster," the company said in a statement.

Andrew Wimer, associate general manager, transportation management at Descartes, said freight brokers play a critical role "in connecting shippers and carriers to efficiently execute transportation moves across North America."

"The acquisition expands our transportation management capabilities for freight brokers and adds valuable transaction, carrier and shipment execution data to the Descartes Global Logistics Network," Wimer said. "We're also pleased to welcome Tai's team of proven domain experts to help accelerate our pace of innovation while best serving our joint customers."

Edward J. Ryan, chief executive officer of Descartes, said transportation networks are becoming increasingly dynamic and complex. "At the same time, AI is changing how our customers manage freight, capacity and execution. Tai complements our strengths in carrier onboarding, compliance, fraud prevention and real-time visibility."

The CEO said by combining the two companies' solutions, "We see a significant opportunity to help freight brokers navigate change, streamline freight execution, improve operating margins, strengthen customer and carrier relationships and support digital transformation."
